title: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Identification
description: Every package shall bear the name and address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and packer. In case of imported packages, the name and address of the importer shall be mentioned on the package.

title: Country of Origin for Imported Products
description: In case of imported packages, the country of origin shall be declared on the package.

title: Common or Generic Name of Product
description: Every package shall bear the common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package.

title: Net Quantity Declaration
description: Every package shall bear the net quantity of the commodity in terms of standard unit of weight or measure. Where the commodity is sold by number, the number of commodity contained in the package shall be mentioned.

title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
description: Every package shall bear the retail sale price of the package. The retail sale price shall be the maximum price at which the commodity in packaged form may be sold to the ultimate consumer. This price shall be inclusive of all taxes.

title: Dimensions Declaration
description: Where the sizes or dimensions of the commodity contained in the package are relevant, the package shall bear such dimensions.

title: Best Before / Use-By Date
description: Every package of a commodity which may, after a period of time, become unfit for human consumption shall bear the month and year by which the commodity is best used, or the use by date, and the month and year of its manufacture or packing.

title: Consumer Care Details
description: Every package shall bear the name or designation, address, telephone number, and email address of the person or office who or which can be contacted in case of consumer complaint.

title: Cosmetics Origin Symbol
description: In case of Cosmetics, a symbol indicating whether the cosmetic product is of vegetarian origin or non-vegetarian origin shall be displayed on the principal display panel. Green dot for vegetarian, red/brown dot for non-vegetarian origin.

title: Barcode / GTIN / QR Code
description: The manufacturer or packer or importer may indicate the retail sale price on the package by way of stamps or stickers or online printing or by way of any other means including bar code, Quick Response Code (QR Code) with Global Trade Item Number (GTIN).

title: Declaration Securely Affixed
description: Every declaration required to be made on any package shall not be easily separable from the package. Inspector confirmation required.

title: Declaration Legible and Conspicuous
description: Every declaration shall be in such form and manner as to be plain, definite and conspicuous, and shall be legible. Inspector confirmation required.

title: Declaration on Principal Display Panel
description: Every declaration shall be made on the principal display panel or otherwise visibly placed on the package. Inspector confirmation required.
